instruction:
One-Storey Market Hall Conversion

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required output as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey and exactly 14 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, at least 1 IfcSlab entity, and at least 3 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: STALL-1, STALL-2, STALL-3, STALL-4, STALL-5, STALL-6, STALL-7, STALL-8, STALL-9, STALL-10, AISLE, COLD-STORE, DRY-STORE, and ARCADE.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [32.0, 10.0, 4.6].

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
